memberdef.name: mbedtls_ssl_ticket_setup

briefdescription.para: Prepare context to be actually used.

parameterdescription.para: AEAD cipher to use for ticket protection. Recommended value: MBEDTLS_CIPHER_AES_256_GCM.
Tickets lifetime in seconds Recommended value: 86400 (one day).

simplesect.para: It is highly recommended to select a cipher that is at least as strong as the strongest ciphersuite supported. Usually that means a 256-bit key.
It is recommended to pick a reasonable lifetime so as not to negate the benefits of forward secrecy.

The TLS 1.3 specification states that ticket lifetime must be smaller than seven days. If ticket lifetime has been set to a value greater than seven days in this module then if the TLS 1.3 is configured to send tickets after the handshake it will fail the connection when trying to send the first ticket.
0 if successful, or a specific MBEDTLS_ERR_XXX error code

memberdef.name: mbedtls_ssl_ticket_rotate

briefdescription.para: Rotate session ticket encryption key to new specified key. Provides for external control of session ticket encryption key rotation, e.g. for synchronization between different machines. If this function is not used, or if not called before ticket lifetime expires, then a new session ticket encryption key is generated internally in order to avoid unbounded session ticket encryption key lifetimes.

parameterdescription.para: Session ticket encryption key name length in bytes
Session ticket encryption key length in bytes
Tickets lifetime in seconds Recommended value: 86400 (one day).

simplesect.para: name and k are recommended to be cryptographically random data.
klength must be sufficient for use by cipher specified to mbedtls_ssl_ticket_setup
